audit.whatIsWrong: Layers disagreed at Level 6 (full: Ekko 7/10, content win[4]: Mel with a why written about level 5), and full rows 0-3, 5-6 were blanket 'Skill' while content named sides.
audit.why: Chronobreak (110s, untargetable rewind + heal) opens Ekko's dive window at 6; pre-6 melee Ekko must walk into Mel's 950-range poke with no escape reset. Mel 1-5, Ekko 6 onward.
audit.corrected: Content win[4] moved to Ekko with matching why; full rows aligned with grounded whys/ratings, one atomic chart group.

audit.why: Spikes correctly place Mel's window pre-6, Ekko's flip at 6 (Chronobreak), his roam snowball at first item, and his flank/reset pattern late. All 4 entries present.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four flagged missing interactions (Chronobreak untargetability through your commit, W shield absorbing burst, Phase Dive auto-reset tell, R sustain), no digits in cooldowns, two bleed bullets.
audit.why: Chronobreak 110/80/50s makes him untargetable and heals — final damage must wait it out. W Parallel Convergence is 22s and shields him inside the anomaly. Phase Dive is an auto-reset whose wind-up is the step-back cue. Timewinder (9s) is a projectile on both passes — Rebuttal's best target here.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns bullet carries Chronobreak/W/Q numbers and the wait-it-out rule; tradeBad now names the Phase Dive auto-reset tell; dosFull[1].d grounds the reflect on Timewinder's two passes.

audit.why: R 110s, W 22s, Q 9s gate every window.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal vs Chronobreak's heal is flagged as a missing interaction and itemization never mentions it.
audit.why: Chronobreak heals a percentage of recent damage — Grievous Wounds before his R blunts the reset.
audit.corrected: Not edited (report[8] is outside the sweep and already at budget); recorded here for the user.
